# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

No additional fixes were applied in this Apply Fixes stage. The latest review approved the round-9 budget-tracking amendments without follow-up changes, so the code remains as produced in the most recent implement stage.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Reviewed the latest validation output and confirmed the round-9 review approved the implementation with no required amendments.
2. [Completed] Verified that no additional code or documentation edits were necessary for the budget-helper coverage updates, water-change residue note, or particulate plant/algae loss routing.
3. [Skipped] Rerun validation after applying fixes.

## Validation Evidence

- Review outcome was `approved` with no follow-up amendments or blocking findings.
- No new validation commands were run in this stage because no code changed.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test budget_tracking -- --nocapture` previously passed (18 tests).
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test plant_algae_integration -- --nocapture` previously passed (8 tests).
- `cargo test -p tank_core` previously passed across the full `tank_core` suite (183 tests across 23 test binaries).
- `cargo clippy -p tank_core -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --all -- --check` previously passed.

## Outstanding Risks

- The structural canonical-helper coverage guard remains convention-based rather than reflective; future explicit N/C-bearing fields with non-standard names or fields hidden in empty-by-default collections will require extending the discovery rules and tests.
- Shrimp eggs remain implicit until hatch; mass is conserved through reserve-backed funding, but a future phase may still want an explicit egg or clutch biomass pool for clearer persistence and tracing.
- Daily plant/algae "respiration" losses are currently modeled as particulate turnover into `fine_detritus_g_total`; if a later phase wants literal metabolic respiration with O2/DIC coupling, the parameter naming and routing will need to be revisited together.
- Complex multi-process stages such as `system:nitrogen_cycle` still rely on snapshot-derived gross component budgets, so same-component turnover inside one stage can remain collapsed until those stages emit fully explicit source/sink deltas.
